note: Questions written on 2026-09-29 for randomly sampled provisions (scripts/sample-provisions.ts, seed 20260929, 12 per area plus 6 spares). Written before any system run on them. Facts are short verbatim phrases from the sampled provision; scripts/build-heldout-3.ts checks them and computes accepted documents.

exclusionRules.E1: the sentence is itself an amendment instruction (substituted, inserted, omitted, rescinded) or the commencement of an amendment
exclusionRules.E2: the sentence is cut by footnote text or garbled
exclusionRules.E3: the sentence cannot stand alone as a question (table or form fragment, refers to 'abovementioned')
exclusionRules.E4: duplicate of an already selected provision (another version of the same rule)
